title: Integrating multimodal cancer data using deep latent variable path modelling

evidence_spans.quote: We additionally performed successful applications of the model
using breast cancer data from The Cancer Genome Atlas

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This original empirical cancer-data analysis contains no analyzed aging construct; multi-omics is therefore not assessed under PRISMA short-circuiting.

evidence_spans.quote: map dependencies between single-nucleotide variant, methylation profiles, microRNA sequencing, RNA sequencing and histological data
superior performance in mapping associations between data types

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report maps dependencies and associations across data types; it does not state a causal or directed identification design.

evidence_spans.quote: We introduce a method called deep latent variable path modelling
using breast cancer data from The Cancer Genome Atlas
map dependencies between single-nucleotide variant, methylation profiles, microRNA sequencing, RNA sequencing and histological data

adjudication.concise_rationale: This is an original biological cancer-data analysis, but no aging construct is analyzed. PRISMA short-circuiting therefore makes multi-omics not assessed and sets the causal-design fields to the required noncausal values.
